name: Lesly Tech Appointment Booking
author: leslytechllc

sections.description:
Lesly Tech Appointment Booking is a multilingual online booking plugin built for small businesses: salons, barbershops, clinics, consultants, driving schools, churches and any business that takes appointments.

Your customers book in their language. The booking form and every customer email are available in English, French, Spanish and Haitian Creole — the customer picks their language on the form, and the confirmation and reminder emails arrive in that same language. Very few booking plugins serve French-, Spanish- and Creole-speaking customers properly. Lesly Tech Appointment Booking was built for them first.

What it does

  • Services — name, duration, price, description, active/inactive.
  • Staff members — assign each person to the services they provide.
  • Weekly hours — one time range per weekday, per staff member.
  • Public booking form — add [leslytech_booking] to any page. The customer chooses a service, a staff member (or “No preference”), a date, and sees only the time slots that are really free: available slots are computed from weekly hours minus existing bookings, in steps equal to the service duration.
  • Confirmation emails — the customer receives an immediate confirmation in their chosen language; the business receives a notification for every new booking.
  • Automatic reminders — a reminder email is sent to the customer before the appointment (adjustable lead time, 24 hours by default), via WP-Cron.
  • Simple admin — manage bookings (pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed), services, staff, schedules and settings, plus an About / Legal screen.

Private by design

Lesly Tech Appointment Booking stores everything in your own WordPress database. It makes no external calls, opens no account anywhere, and includes no tracking. A full privacy policy and intellectual property declaration ship inside the plugin (Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > About / Legal).

Honest scope

Version 1.0 is a complete, free booking tool for the features above — no trialware, no locked screens. It does not process payments: customers pay your business directly, as most small businesses already work. A Pro version with booking deposits and SMS reminders is planned.

Lesly Tech Appointment Booking is a product of Lesly Tech LLC.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the randevou folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Lesly Tech Appointment Booking in the Plugins menu. Its tables and default settings are created automatically.
  3. Go to Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > Services and add your first service; then Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > Staff to add staff, assign services and set weekly hours.
  4. Create a page and add the [leslytech_booking] shortcode — that page is your booking form.
  5. Check Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > Settings: notification email, reminder lead time, automatic confirmation on/off, and the default language.
sections.faq:
Is Lesly Tech Appointment Booking really free?

Yes. Version 1.0 is complete for its scope: services, staff, weekly hours, the public booking form, confirmation emails and automatic reminder emails. There are no locked features and no trial period. A Pro version with booking deposits (Stripe) and SMS reminders is planned, but nothing in the free version depends on it.

Which languages are supported?

English, French, Spanish and Haitian Creole. The customer selects their language directly on the booking form, and the confirmation and reminder emails are sent in that language. The business notification and the admin screens use the default language chosen in Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > Settings.

Does Lesly Tech Appointment Booking take payments or deposits?

No. Version 1.0 does not process payments — your customers pay your business directly. Online deposits are planned for a future Pro version.

Does Lesly Tech Appointment Booking send my data to Lesly Tech LLC or any third party?

No. All booking data is stored in your own WordPress database. The plugin makes no network calls of its own and includes no analytics or tracking. The full privacy policy is included in the plugin under Lesly Tech Appointment Booking > About / Legal.

How do the reminder emails work?

Reminders are sent by WP-Cron. Each hour, Lesly Tech Appointment Booking checks for confirmed bookings starting within the reminder window (24 hours by default, adjustable in Settings) and emails those customers once, in their language. Like every WP-Cron task, it runs when your site receives visits; on low-traffic sites, configuring a real system cron for wp-cron.php makes timing more reliable.

Can a customer book without choosing a specific staff member?

Yes. The form offers “No preference”: the booking is assigned to the first available staff member who provides the chosen service at the selected time.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Renamed to Lesly Tech Appointment Booking: the former name was too close to existing booking services.
  • New: booking form theme – light, dark, or left to the visitor (choice remembered), configurable in the settings.
  • The Lesly Tech LLC credit under the public booking form is now opt-in: it stays hidden unless the site owner enables it in the settings.

1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Services and staff management with weekly hours.
  • Public booking form ([leslytech_booking]) with real-time free-slot computation.
  • Booking form and customer emails in English, French, Spanish and Haitian Creole.
  • Confirmation emails, business notifications and automatic reminder emails (WP-Cron).
  • Privacy policy and intellectual property declaration included (About / Legal screen).
